attributeKey.description: Attribute key where generated values are stored

pattern.description: Number format using supported tokens such as {YEAR} and {SEQUENCE}

startAt.description: First sequence number allocated for a new period

padding.description: Minimum width of the generated sequence number, padded with leading zeroes

reset.description: Frequency at which the sequence restarts at startAt
reset.title: NumberingSequenceReset

timezone.description: IANA timezone used to determine the active period; defaults to UTC

currentPeriod.description: Active sequence period, or null if no number has been allocated

currentSequence.description: Most recently allocated sequence number, or null if none has been allocated

lastValue.description: Most recently generated attribute value, or null if none has been allocated
